name: Print Center
author: David Reed
description: Manage CUPS printers and the print queue from your Omarchy bar. A pill shows the default printer's state and queue depth, turning accent or urgent when a printer needs paper, ink, or attention. The popup lists printers with ink levels; cancel, hold, or release jobs; set your default; print a test page; add a driverless network printer. A headless service notifies you when a job finishes, is held, or a printer errors. A Scan tab drives SANE scanners (optional; installs its packages on request).

barWidget.description: The default printer's state and queue depth in the bar, going accent/urgent when a printer needs paper or ink. Popup: printer list with ink levels, cancel/hold/release jobs, set default, test page, add a network printer. Desktop notifications for finished, held, and errored jobs.

schema.label: Notify for which events (comma list): done,error,held - or 'all'
Auto-dismiss notification after N seconds (0 = daemon default)
Printer the bar pill tracks (blank = system default)
Show the queued-job count in the bar pill: on or off
Clicking an error notification opens printer settings: on or off
Default scan format: pdf, png or jpeg
Check GitHub for a newer release: on or off
How often to check for updates (hours, minimum 1)
Log raw CLI output to the shell log: on or off
